opportunities.title: LemonExitBridge: Zero-Install Lemon Squeezy Shutdown CSV Auditor, PayPal Prorated Re-Auth Splitter & Legacy License Key Bridge for Stripe / Polar
opportunities.target_software: Lemon Squeezy to Stripe Managed Payments & Polar.sh
opportunities.pain: Lemon Squeezy closed new stores on Nov 16, 2026 and shuts down all billing on March 31, 2027, but PayPal subscriptions cannot transfer to Stripe/Polar, Stripe Managed Payments has no built-in license key manager, and raw Lemon Squeezy CSV exports dump unlinked orders instead of prorated trial_end migration rows.
opportunities.solution: 100% local in-browser Web App (+ Python CLI .whl) that joins exported Lemon Squeezy Orders, Subscriptions, and License Keys CSVs, isolates at-risk PayPal MRR vs. transferable Card subscribers, calculates exact Unix trial_end timestamps so re-subscribing customers are never double-charged, and exports Stripe Billing / Polar migration CSVs plus a drop-in Legacy License Key JSON/Worker bundle.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Stripe's guided card migration does not transfer PayPal subscribers or software license keys; Polar's importer does not compute PayPal prorated trial_end cohorts or legacy Lemon Squeezy XXXX-XXXX key shims from raw Orders CSVs.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Lemon Squeezy's native 'Export CSV' dumps flat order histories without joining license keys, isolating non-transferable PayPal subscriptions, or calculating Unix trial_end timestamps for Stripe/Polar.

opportunities.title: PrismaSqlLens: Offline Prisma-to-SQL Compiler & Non-Destructive Supabase Drift Repair
opportunities.pain: Prisma migrate forces destructive database resets on Supabase schema drift (#19100), lacks offline .getRawQuery() SQL compilation (#5052: 204 upvotes), and lacks serverless VPC migration bundles (#4703: 512 upvotes)
opportunities.solution: Zero-dependency CLI that compiles schema.prisma & query blocks into raw PostgreSQL DDL/SQL offline, generates non-destructive _prisma_migrations SHA-256 drift repair SQL, and bundles serverless migrations

opportunities.title: VaultShield: Static Exfiltration Scanner & SHA-256 Lockfile for Obsidian Plugins
opportunities.pain: Obsidian community plugins run unsandboxed with full Node/Electron fs, child_process, and network access, abused in real-world RAT campaigns (366 HN pts / 229 comments)
opportunities.solution: Local CLI scanner that audits .obsidian/plugins/*/main.js for child_process/eval/exfiltration domains, enforces SHA-256 plugin-lock.json integrity, and diffs updates

opportunities.title: OssVatBridge: Zero-Install Stripe Tax, Shopify & Lemon Squeezy to EU VAT OSS Bulk CSV/XML Compiler
opportunities.target_software: Stripe Tax / Shopify / Lemon Squeezy -> EU VAT OSS (Germany BZSt BOP, Ireland ROS, EU27)
opportunities.pain: Merchants moving off Lemon Squeezy to Stripe Tax or Shopify inherit quarterly EU VAT OSS filings, but tax portals reject raw mixed-currency Stripe/Shopify CSVs and compliance SaaS charges $35-$299/mo.
opportunities.solution: 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that merges Stripe Tax, Shopify, and Lemon Squeezy CSVs, normalizes currencies via ECB quarterly rates, aggregates EU27 Member-State VAT by Standard/Reduced rate, and exports Germany BZSt/BOP semicolon CSV, Ireland ROS XML, and EU27 OSS audit ledgers.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Quaderno ($49-$149/mo), Lovat ($35-$115/mo), GoodVat, Anrok/Taxually ($99-$299/mo) require recurring fees + live OAuth; GitHub has only dev-only single-country PHP/Python CLI scripts.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Raw Stripe Tax and Shopify exports dump un-aggregated per-charge rows in mixed currencies with dot decimals and comma delimiters that Germany BZSt/BOP (1,000-row cap, semicolon delimiter, comma decimal) and Ireland ROS XML reject immediately.

opportunities.title: LinearBridge: 1-Click Notion PRD to Linear Sub-Issues & Sync
opportunities.pain: Linear's native Notion integration is read-only link unfurling; teams manually copy-paste PRD checklists into Linear issues or pay for brittle Zapier polling.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension injecting a 'Push PRD to Linear' action bar inside Notion that decomposes headings/checklists into Linear parent + sub-issues and syncs status badges locally via user API keys.

opportunities.title: AmzSettlementBridge: Zero-Install Amazon Seller Flat-File V2 (.TXT/.TSV) to Xero, QuickBooks & DATEV Clearing Journal Compiler
opportunities.target_software: Amazon Seller Central Settlement V2 -> Xero / QuickBooks Online / DATEV
opportunities.pain: Amazon 14-day payouts bundle thousands of lines across 40+ FBA/referral/storage/PPC fee codes and rolling Account-Level Reserves; net-deposit bookkeeping breaks VAT/COGS and A2X/Link My Books charge $17-$199/mo.
opportunities.solution: 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that parses Amazon Seller Central Flat-File V2 (.txt/.tsv) settlements locally, separates Principal sales, Marketplace Facilitator tax, FBA/referral/storage/PPC fees, refunds, and rolling reserves into integer-cent balanced Xero, QuickBooks, and DATEV clearing journals.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: A2X ($29-$199/mo), Link My Books ($17-$199/mo), Taxomate, and Synder ($52-$150+/mo) require recurring monthly subscriptions gated by order tiers plus permanent SP-API and accounting OAuth tokens; zero commercial browser-local tools exist.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Amazon Flat-File V2 dumps thousands of ungrouped order/fee rows plus rolling reserve holdbacks/releases that Xero, QBO, and DATEV cannot import without error-prone manual Excel pivot tables and cent-rounding mismatches.

opportunities.title: StripePayoutBridge: Zero-Install Stripe & PayPal Payout CSV to Xero, QuickBooks & DATEV Clearing Journal Splitter
opportunities.target_software: Stripe & PayPal to Xero / QuickBooks / DATEV
opportunities.pain: Stripe and PayPal deposit net lump sums into the bank after deducting fees, refunds, disputes, and FX markups; recording net deposits as revenue violates VAT/GoBD rules and manual CSV reconciliation takes hours at month-end.
opportunities.solution: 100% local in-browser Web App (+ CLI) that parses Stripe/PayPal itemized payout CSVs, groups transactions by payout batch into balanced double-entry clearing account journals (Gross Sales by tax rate, Processing Fees, Refunds/Disputes, FX fees, Net Transfer), and exports Xero Manual Journal CSV, QuickBooks Journal CSV, and DATEV Buchungsstapel CSV.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: A2X, Synder, and Link My Books cost -/mo recurring with transaction caps and require full live OAuth access to both Stripe and Xero/QuickBooks.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Stripe native 'Itemized Payout Reconciliation CSV' is a flat transaction dump that Xero, QuickBooks, and DATEV reject because it is not grouped by payout ID into balanced double-entry debit/credit clearing journal lines.

opportunities.title: NotionGuestBridge: 1-Click Client Notion Guest Workspace to Claude/Cursor Context & MCP Pack

opportunities.existing_alternatives: Official Notion MCP rejects guest OAuth; upgrading costs clients paid Member seats; private token_v2 scripts violate Notion ToS and break on auth changes; no official guest extension exists

opportunities.title: EInvoiceLocal: 100% Local XRechnung, ZUGFeRD & Peppol UBL/CII XML Validator, Printable A4 PDF & DATEV/Xero Batch Converter
opportunities.target_software: EU B2B E-Invoicing (XRechnung / ZUGFeRD / Peppol XML -> DATEV / Xero / QuickBooks)
opportunities.pain: Mandatory 2025-2027 EU & German/Belgian EN 16931 B2B e-invoicing forces SMBs and Steuerberater to process raw UBL/CII .xml files, while ERPs cost €19-€79/mo and cloud viewers violate GDPR/GoBD.
opportunities.solution: 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that validates EN 16931 math rules across UBL 2.1 and UN/CEFACT CII XML invoices, renders printable A4 invoice views, and batch-exports unified DATEV EXTF_Buchungsstapel.csv (with BU-Schlüssel tax keys), Xero Bills CSV, and QuickBooks CSV.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Lexoffice, SevDesk, DATEV UO cost €19-€79/mo recurring; Docfaro offers a client-side browser XML-to-Excel/DATEV utility (verified live competitor) but lacks unified Xero/QBO export, printable A4 preview, EN 16931 line-math validation, and offline pip CLI.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Opening XRechnung/Peppol .xml in Chrome or Excel dumps raw <cbc:...>/<cac:...> tags, fails across dual UBL vs. CII syntaxes, and cannot batch-consolidate folders of XMLs into balanced DATEV EXTF or Xero Bills CSVs.

opportunities.title: WebflowAssetZip: 1-Click Webflow CMS CSV Asset Downloader, Rich-Text CDN Rewriter & 301 Redirect Pack
opportunities.pain: Webflow CMS CSV exports leave all image/file columns and inline Rich-Text HTML tags hotlinked to uploads-ssl.webflow.com, so every image breaks into a 404 when Webflow hosting is canceled.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension that parses Webflow CMS CSVs or open CMS collections, downloads and renames every image/asset by item slug, rewrites CSV + Rich-Text HTML CDN URLs to your new host (Framer/S3/R2/WP), and outputs a 301-redirects.csv map.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Webflow Asset Exporter only dumps raw unnamed assets without mapping to CMS slugs or rewriting CSV and Rich-Text HTML tags; generic image scrapers only grab 1 rendered page.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Webflow native 'Export CSV' fails 100% on asset ownership because it only exports hotlinked uploads-ssl.webflow.com URLs that die when the Webflow plan is canceled.

opportunities.title: ShopMetaShift: Zero-Install WooCommerce-to-Shopify Variant Metafield & Option Row-Splitter Web App
opportunities.pain: Shopify's native Product CSV importer drops variant-level custom fields, caps options at 3, and requires strict multi-row parent/child handle splitting and typed Variant Metafield headers, causing WooCommerce variable product CSV exports to fail.
opportunities.solution: 100% local in-browser Web App (+ CLI) that transforms WooCommerce variable/variation CSV exports into valid Shopify Admin & Matrixify-ready multi-row CSVs with typed 'Variant Metafield: custom.key [type]' columns, >3 option overflow mapping, and 301 redirect rules.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Matrixify costs -/mo recurring; LitExtension and Cart2Cart cost -+ per store migration and require full store API credentials.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Shopify native 'Import Products CSV' and free column-rename templates fail on variable products with >3 attributes or custom variant metadata, dropping variant metafields and corrupting parent/variant handle rows.

opportunities.title: NotionGitExport: Lossless Notion Tree & Database to Clean Markdown

opportunities.title: LookerTableExport: Full-Scroll Multi-Page Table & White-Label PDF/CSV Report Packager for Looker Studio

opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension on lookerstudio.google.com that dynamically unrolls scrollable DOM tables before capture, strips Looker footer chrome, injects an agency white-label header, and exports full-row print-ready PDF views + multi-table CSV/Markdown summary packs.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Looker Studio Pro (/user/project/mo) still truncates scrollable tables in PDF exports; Supermetrics/Swydo cost -/mo; Looker Studio Companion focuses on field editing rather than unrolling scrollable tables for PDF/CSV client packs.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Looker Studio native 'Share -> Download Report (PDF)' cuts off every scrollable table below the fold and includes Google/Looker footer branding.
